clue.text: Agreement great king casually rejected — on northerner's head be it?

indicators.note: rejected means thrown back, so the two pieces are read together from end to start

parts.note: a pact is an agreement
Alfred the Great, a king of Wessex, is known casually as Alf

explanation.surface: Someone casually turns down a deal offered by a great king, as if blaming a northerner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' reverses PACT + ALF as one run. The definition is whimsical: the flat cloth cap is the stereotypical headgear of men from the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: The cloth cap with a short brim is a cliché of working men in northern England, so it sits on a northerner's head.

clue.text: Full of beans, loud and dangerous

parts.note: f, forte, is the musical direction for loud
risky means dangerous

explanation.surface: Someone lively, noisy and reckless.
explanation.definitionFit: Full of beans is an idiom for lively, energetic and playful.

clue.text: Prisoner bottling it up after a battle

indicators.note: bottling means holding in, so the prisoner word contains the rest

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word it is read from the bottom upwards

explanation.surface: A prisoner keeps his feelings bottled up after a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bottling' and 'up' are both indicators here; the battle sense of the definition is the old military one, an engagement.
explanation.definitionFit: An action is a military engagement, a fight between forces.

clue.text: British Olympian state isn't able to honour leader in very old swimmer

parts.note: Sebastian Coe is a British Olympic champion runner
LA is Louisiana, a US state
can't means isn't able

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of the word honour

explanation.surface: A British Olympian cannot honour the leader of an ancient swimming fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: Seb Coe won Olympic gold at 1500 metres and ran London's 2012 Games.
explanation.definitionFit: The coelacanth is a fish known from fossils and thought long extinct, an ancient swimmer.

clue.text: Foreign food individual I passed has gobbled up

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the letters are read from the bottom upwards
has gobbled means the words hold the letters inside them

explanation.surface: Someone's meal of foreign food was gobbled up by another as they passed.
explanation.walkthrough: The run UALIP sits across 'individual I passed'; 'up' turns it.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilau is a rice dish of the Middle East and South Asia, foreign to a British table.

clue.text: See 27
With more than one unknown verse, song dividing taste

indicators.note: dividing means splitting the other word by going inside it

parts.note: a bite is a taste of food
an aria is an operatic song

explanation.surface: A verse and song split a taste test with unknown results.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dividing' is the container signal; the definition is a mathematician's phrase, not a person with secrets.
explanation.definitionFit: In statistics and algebra, bivariate means involving two variables, more than one unknown quantity.

clue.text: Raise seat

definitions.meaning: to bring up children or animals
the bottom, the part one sits on

explanation.definitionFit: To rear a child is to raise it, and the rear is the buttocks, one's seat.

clue.text: Proper to support demon, it's suggested

indicators.note: to support in a down clue means placed below the other piece

parts.note: an imp is a little demon
licit means lawful, proper

explanation.surface: It is suggested that it is proper to back a demon.
explanation.definitionFit: Something implicit is implied or understood without being stated directly.

clue.text: Doctor regains gun primarily for applying lubricant

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so these letters are rearranged
primarily means first, so only the opening letter of gun is used

explanation.surface: A doctor gets back his gun for oiling.
explanation.definitionFit: Greasing a part means coating it with oil or fat to make it run smoothly.

clue.text: See 11
Nothing bitter about very soft old fruit

parts.note: love is a score of nothing in tennis

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the beer word goes round the musical mark

parts.note: bitter is a kind of ale, a British beer
pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very soft

explanation.surface: A tasting note on an overripe fruit that has gone soft and bitter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal. 'old' belongs with the definition, because the name for this fruit is now archaic.
explanation.definitionFit: Tomatoes were formerly called love apples, an archaic name for that fruit.

clue.text: American character, a hard worker claiming (wrongly) I'm louder, turns straight round

indicators.note: claiming means taking hold of, so the first pieces close around the rest

parts.note: kook is American slang for an eccentric person, a character
the bee is the proverbial hard worker

indicators.note: wrongly means the letters are put in a wrong order, an anagram signal

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder
taken as written as anagram fodder
taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: An American eccentric, accused of claiming to be louder, does a straight turn.
explanation.walkthrough: '(wrongly)' is the anagram signal and 'claiming' the container. 'round' defines all the long answers: each is a song sung in canon.
explanation.definitionFit: This Australian children's song is sung as a round, with voices entering one after another.

clue.text: See 11
Dare, perhaps, a hundred birds I caught to make a noise at the disco?

parts.note: Dan Dare is the space hero of the British comic Eagle
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
emus are large flightless birds
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Someone dares to catch a hundred birds to make a racket at a disco.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dare' is not a verb: Dan Dare was a 1950s British comic-strip spaceman.
explanation.definitionFit: Dance music is what a disco plays; calling it noise is a jokey grumble, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Asian girl nicks car before outlaw steals one

indicators.note: nicks means steals, so the girl's name takes the car inside it

parts.note: Sara is a girl's name
an Audi is a make of car

indicators.note: steals means takes in, so the prohibition word holds the numeral

parts.note: to outlaw something is to ban it
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A crime report: a girl steals a car, then an outlaw steals something too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nicks' is British slang for steals, and 'steals' then does the same container job a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: A Saudi Arabian is a national of a country in Asia, so a person from that part of the world.

clue.text: Rejects chipped plate with pasty in it

indicators.note: in it means put inside the other piece
chipped means a bit has broken off, here the last letter

parts.note: a dish is a plate
sallow means pale, pasty in complexion

explanation.surface: Someone sends back a chipped plate with a pasty on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pasty' is not the pie but an adjective, pale. 'chipped' cuts the last letter and 'in it' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To disallow a claim or goal is to reject it officially.

clue.text: Country gentleman investing readies initially left hoard

indicators.note: investing means clothing or surrounding, so the gentleman takes a letter inside

parts.note: a squire is a country landowner

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word readies

explanation.surface: A country squire invests his cash and leaves the rest hoarded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'readies' is British slang for cash, but only its R is used, inside SQUIRE.
explanation.definitionFit: To squirrel things away is to store them up, as the animal stores nuts.

clue.text: See 28
Typical example, figure scoffing less (neglecting starter), tucking into fruit

indicators.note: tucking into means placed inside, so the built piece goes inside the fruit

parts.note: the quince is a pear-like fruit

indicators.note: scoffing means eating up, so the number word takes the trimmed word inside

parts.note: ten is a figure, a number

indicators.note: neglecting starter means the first letter of the word less is dropped

explanation.surface: A dieter's menu where a figure eats less, skips the starter and tucks into fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neglecting starter' drops a first letter, 'scoffing' and 'tucking into' are both container signals, one nested in the other.
explanation.definitionFit: The quintessence of something is its purest, most typical instance, its perfect embodiment.

clue.text: Many ships separated centrally, bearing round the bend

indicators.note: bearing means carrying, so the middle letters hold the other piece
centrally means taking the middle letters of the word separated

parts.note: round the bend is British slang for mad

explanation.surface: A fleet split down the middle while going round a bend in the river.
explanation.walkthrough: Here the middle is the three central letters ARA, which hold MAD.
explanation.definitionFit: An armada is a large fleet of warships, many vessels together.

clue.text: Celebrate hosting a show

indicators.note: hosting means having a guest inside, so the party word takes the letter in

parts.note: to revel is to celebrate

explanation.surface: A party celebrating while hosting a show.
explanation.definitionFit: To reveal something is to show it, making it known or visible.

clue.text: Isle where the moon doesn't apply?

parts.note: Io is a moon of Jupiter
NA stands for not applicable

explanation.surface: A riddle about a place where the moon has no bearing.
explanation.walkthrough: Io is one of Jupiter's moons; NA is 'not applicable', written on forms.
explanation.definitionFit: Iona is a small island of the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland.

clue.text: See 11
Flash bottom in style with glitzy clothing

indicators.note: clothing means dressing round, so the glitzy word surrounds a letter

parts.note: glam, short for glamorous, means glitzy

indicators.note: bottom in a down clue means the last letter of the word style

explanation.surface: A flash of someone's bottom in glitzy fashion clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A gleam is a brief flash of light.

clue.text: Tree getting round county

parts.note: may is hawthorn, a tree
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A tree growing round a county.
explanation.walkthrough: MAYO is a county in the west of Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Mayo is one of the counties of the Republic of Ireland.

clue.text: Bound to embrace good character after a performance

indicators.note: to embrace means to hold inside, so the boundary word takes the abbreviation in

parts.note: a rim is a bound, an edge or limit
a role is a character in a play

explanation.surface: An actor is bound to take on a good character after a performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' only joins the clue: ROLE follows A in the answer. 'performance' is a fuss, not a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A rigmarole is a lengthy, tiresome procedure, which in British idiom is called a performance or palaver.

clue.text: Put on step

definitions.meaning: to put on a play is to mount it
a step is a phase or ... in a process

explanation.definitionFit: To stage a play is to put it on, and a stage is also one step in a process.

clue.text: Possible headline during riots getting round

definitions.meaning: a newspaper headline that the 2011 riots in the capital might prompt
a song sung in canon, voices entering in turn

explanation.surface: A newspaper headline during riots, spreading round.
explanation.walkthrough: The riots of August 2011 began in London. The answer is also a traditional children's song sung as a round.
explanation.definitionFit: The nursery song about the Great Fire is sung as a round, and the words fit a riot headline.

clue.text: Person admitting failing, hence turning round

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the person word holds the rest

parts.note: man is a person

indicators.note: turning means the letters are twisted into a new order, an anagram signal

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder
taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Someone owns up to a failing and so turns around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' is the anagram signal and 'admitting' the container. The definition is the last word, a song sung in canon, not a turn.
explanation.definitionFit: The nonsense song about a man with whiskers on his chin is sung as a round.
